text:
olivia: quick heads-up — ran the priming + int8 rerank sweep on the new 13B. short summary: ~2.2x cost savings, ~3% hit on nDCG@10 for our rerank set. thinking we can use this for low-cost tier with careful rollout :chart_with_upwards_trend:

devin: nice. which dataset + prompt template?

olivia: rerank-slice-v4 (prod-like queries). same priming we ship for gtn. prompts stable.

sam: can you paste the perf numbers? p50/p95 latency and tokens per second?

olivia: p50=85ms, p95=260ms for 512-token context on p4d; throughput ~55 tok/s per replica. int8 vs fp16 comparison in short: cost per 1M tokens fp16=$12.4, int8=$5.6.

rachel: 3% nDCG drop — any particular categories hit worse? end-user impact?

olivia: conversational reranks and long-tail brand queries show larger drop (~5-6%). short Q/A and generic relevance mostly flat.

devin: can we mitigate w/ hybrid routing? e.g., route high-confidence or short contexts to int8; fallback to fp16 on low confidence.

sam: did a cheap classifier on top of the model score — with a 0.2 threshold we can catch ~70% of likely-break cases and route them. adds ~3ms.

olivia: exact numbers: fallback fraction ~12% of traffic, end-to-end latency increase for those ~+90ms, weighted avg latency +10ms. cost win still ~1.9x.

ci-bot: deploy-check: canary config "int8-hybrid-routing-v1" created by olivia at 1767004365.

rachel: product note — if we enable this for "economy" tier, need copy for behavior change + opt-in telemetry for queries routed to fp16 for 1 week. also need rollback window.

devin: agree. ops checklist: 1) canary 1% global 2) enable telemetry flag 3) run signal parity slice every 6h 4) if nDCG delta > 2.5% on any slice -> rollback.

sam: small reproducible snippet for perf measurement so infra can sanity-check: ```bash
# perf-run simplified
python microbench.py --model redwood-13b-int8 --context 512 --batch 1 --steps 200
# expect ~55 tok/s
```

olivia: also ran priming-ablation: removing repeated system tokens recovered ~0.6% nDCG without cost change. small prompt tweak might be worth it before rollout.

rachel: recommendation summary for GTN: 1) ship int8 on economy tier with hybrid routing 2) enable opt-in telemetry and user-facing note 3) prompt tweak during canary to reduce regressions 4) check top-brand queries daily for first week.

devin: +1. who wants to own the canary?

olivia: I'll own the canary + metric dashboard. sam can validate perf. rachel to handle product comms.

sam: will run infra validation today, post results in this thread.

olivia: thanks — tagging @rachel for the product checklist. :thumbsup:
notes: thread about bringing up int8 rerank for cost savings with hybrid routing and product rollout checklist
